title: Software Management Policy
definition: Maintain a system to maintain an inventory of the organization's approved software.

title: Software Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's software inventory system records appropriate demographics for each software application.

title: Software Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's software inventory system regularly updates the software inventory via an automated discovery tool.

title: Software Management Policy
category: SW-04 Hardware and Software Inventory Correlation
definition: Ensure the organization's software inventory system correlates the organization's hardware and software inventories in the same system.

title: Software Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's software inventory system validates that all software in the inventory is still supported by the software vendor.

title: Software Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's software inventory system validates that all operating system software in the organization's software inventory is kept up to date.

title: Software Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's software inventory system validates that all application software in the organization's software inventory is kept up to date.

title: Software Management Policy
definition: Maintain a Service Level Agreement (SLA) for the organization to define how often software updates must be performed on each software application.

title: Software Management Policy
definition: Define a process the organization will use to ensure all software adheres to the organization's approved software-update Service Level Agreement (SLA).

title: Software Management Policy
definition: Maintain a software application control system on each of the organization's computing systems to ensure that only authorized software can execute.

title: Software Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's application control system only allows the execution of authorized binaries on each of the organization's computing systems.

title: Software Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's application control system only allows authorized software libraries, such as DLLs, on each of the organization's computing systems.

title: Software Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's application control system only allows the use of authorized software scripts on each of the organization's computing systems.

title: Software Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's application control system only allows the use of authorized operating system shells, such as Microsoft PowerShell or BASH, on each of its computing systems.

title: Software Management Policy
definition: Define a process the organization will use to remove unauthorized software from each of its computing systems in a timely manner.
